title: Quasinormal modes and shadow of Schwarzschild-Tangherlini black hole with GUP
summary: In this work, we investigate quasinormal modes and the shadow of a Schwarzschild-Tangherlini black hole in $(d+1)$ dimensions, incorporating corrections arising from the Generalized Uncertainty Principle (GUP). Using the WKB approximation up to sixth order, we calculate the quasinormal frequencies for $l=1, 2$ and $d=3, 4, 5, 6$, and analyze the effects of the dimensionless linear and quadratic GUP parameters $\barα$ and $\barβ$, respectively. We find that the linear correction increases the oscillation frequency and the damping rate, whereas the quadratic correction produces the opposite…
